measurement: Seven timing batches. Core counters use three passes; branch and L1D event pairs use separate nonmultiplexed passes. Counts are divided by actual API iterations. For every parameter set, the API with the highest median measured wall time is selected. The compact table uses five L1 parameters and reports API, IPC, branch and L1D-load counts, branch-miss rate, and L1D-load-miss rate; parameter identities and complete counters remain in the archive. QR-UOV uses 1q127L3. PMU metrics are per-case medians. Hotspots are period-weighted self samples, not wall-clock fractions.
